column8: ∀ (left right : List Bool), left.length = right.length → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.bitsToNat left = Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.bitsToNat right → left = right

∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema), List.find? (fun x => x.default) s.roles = Option.none → s.chosenBase Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.RoleBasis.none = Option.some []

∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema) (roleId : ℕ), s.chosenBase (Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.RoleBasis.role roleId) = Option.map (fun x => x.permissions) s.roles[roleId]?

∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {s : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema}, Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.schemaCodec.decode bytes = Option.some s → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.schemaCodec.encode s = bytes

∀ (base : List Bool) (assignment : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.RoleAssignment) (i : ℕ) (p : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Permission), assignment.removed.contains p.name = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema.resolveBit base assignment i p = Bool.false

∀ (s : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema) (base : List Bool) (assignment : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.RoleAssignment) (denied : List Bool), { version := s.version, permissions := s.permissions, roles := s.roles, denied := denied }.resolveVector base assignment = s.resolveVector base assignment
List Bool → List Bool → Prop := fun requested ceiling => requested.length = ceiling.length ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), requested[i]?.getD Bool.false = Bool.true → ceiling[i]?.getD Bool.false = Bool.true
